scenarios.detail: Next template home preview is served
Edited app/about/page.tsx is served for the non-root route
A new app/contact/page.tsx is served at /contact without a studio page list
A new folder is a directory and does not create a marker file
Moving a folder renames descendant files and leaves the old path
Deleting a folder removes the directory and its files
A package.json dependency is installed and the preview module imports it
Preview package install runs postinstall and keeps its stdout
A later preview start does not replace an installed package with the adapter fixture
The adapter preview serves the page module but does not evaluate console.log. Studio console forwarding is covered by the browser preview bridge.
runPreview only installs, starts the dev server, and binds the preview session. It has no project server save call.
